source: https://play.pokemonshowdown.com/sprites/ani/carbink.gif (Showdown's own floating sprite; pixel data read in the browser, not downloaded)
method: same rules as check_loop / flicker_map (ported to JS): blinks = colour runs <= 2 frames, dark = the darkest (outline) colour, pops = biggest connected patch of change not explained by a 1-px shift. Rates are per frame and per solid pixel; pop_max_norm = pop_max / sqrt(solid_px / 1000); big_pops_share = steps with a pop >= 2 / steps.
why: A floating sprite in Showdown is re-rendered every frame (sub-pixel motion, ~25 % of its pixels change per frame); the absolute limits calibrated on Lapras (whose idle barely moves) would fail Showdown's own Carbink 1000x.
